messages:
Oliver (AE): Quick sync — need to lock scope+success criteria for ACME deal. Customer wants a 4‑6 week pilot and expects SLOs, sample prompts, and a runbook for cutover.
Jules (SE): Got it. Do they want hosted or dedicated for pilot? That changes resource needs.
Oliver (AE): They asked for dedicated capacity for throughput guarantees, but are open to hosted if we can meet latency. Pricing question pending.
Maya (Eng): For dedicated we'll need 1x A100 equivalent for baseline traffic, SE support for first 2 weeks, and an eng oncall rotation for the pilot.
Priyanka (SRE): Also need to confirm networking: will they allow a peered VPC or do we need a transit setup? That affects timeline.
Kyle (SE): I can lead SE tasks. Proposed deliverables: onboarding checklist, eval prompt set, automated eval harness, monitoring dashboard, rollback plan.
Oliver (AE): Can we draft concrete success criteria? Customer will sign-off if both quality and latency targets met.
Jules (SE): Suggested success criteria (short):
- Latency p95 < 250ms on 8k tokens workload
- Quality: top-1 accuracy on our eval set >= 85% (we'll define prompts)
- Error rate < 0.5%
- Seamless auth & logging in place
(we'll provide the eval notebook)
Maya (Eng): Timeline sketch:
```
Week 0: SOW + infra signoff, network config
Week 1: Provision dedicated pool, baseline perf tests
Week 2: Prompt tuning + eval harness runs
Week 3: Integrate monitoring + cost checks
Week 4: Customer UAT and signoff
Week 5-6: Buffer for optimizations / canary rollouts
```
Jules (SE): Resource ask: SE onsite/remote hours: 40h across Weeks 1-3. Eng support: oncall + 2 deep dives (4-6h each).
Oliver (AE): Pricing note — customer asked for a predictable rate for pilot. I'll push for a short-term committed rate for the dedicated pool.
Priyanka (SRE): One blocker: their security team requires KMS integration and an audit export every 24h. Can we confirm KMS provider?
Maya (Eng): We support AWS KMS and customer-managed keys in the private deployment. For hosted we'll need to enable customer KMS via contract.
Kyle (SE): I'll prepare the prompt set draft and eval rubric by EOD tomorrow. Need sample user queries from ACME — @Oliver can you get those?
Oliver (AE): On it. Also looping in legal to fast-track the data processing addendum.
deploy-bot: Deployment checklist created: https://redwood.example/runbooks/deploys/1894506789 - initial entry.
Jules (SE): Next actions: 1) Oliver to confirm network/KMS constraints (by Tue), 2) Kyle to share prompts + rubric (by EOD Mon), 3) Maya to confirm infra sizing and staffing (by Wed), 4) Draft success criteria doc for customer review (SE + AE).
Oliver (AE): Thanks — if we can get those items on schedule we should hit Week 4 signoff. :thumbsup:
Kyle (SE): I'll post the prompt draft in this thread when ready.
Maya (Eng): FYI I reserved a 2‑hour deep dive slot for Wed 10am PT for infra/ops walkthrough.
Priyanka (SRE): I'll prepare the audit/export checklist and share any additional compliance asks.
Oliver (AE): Great sync. Closing loop when legal confirms DPA timing.
